summary: The authors deposited complete-case DESeq2 tables and significant-gene lists for 17 comparisons. Six compare ages within females. None estimates the whole-hypothalamus change from female PND22 to PND37.

manualReview.summary: Author DESeq2 results cover six female age contrasts. The registered PND37 versus PND22 contrast is absent.
manualReview.note: Sokolowski et al. profiled individual C57BL/6J hypothalami by bulk 3′-UTR sequencing at five ages in both sexes. HypoExplorer fits edgeR-QL to five female PND37 mice and five female PND22 controls. The Figure 2 script fits each pair separately with the control as the DESeq2 reference. Its female baseline-to-case pairs are 12→22, 22→27, 27→32, 32→37, 22→32 and 27→37. Both deposited lists have those six comparisons. The larger list retains rows with complete DESeq2 results, including log2 fold change, raw P and adjusted P. The selected list applies adjusted P < 0.05 and absolute log2 fold change > log2(1.5). The Zenodo and GitHub app copies contain the same DE object. Its PValue, F and logCPM columns equal one throughout all 17 frames.
reviewFlags: The registered PMID describes the companion pituitary experiment. The hypothalamus publication is PMID 39449090.
Expression trajectories, cell-proportion tests and age-by-sex component scores have different estimands from the female whole-tissue endpoint.
The file 12M_vs_12F_volcano.pdf contains panels titled 32_vs_37_F. The Figure 2 code and the two serialized result lists establish the comparison identities.

verificationReview.reason: All ten registered libraries map to the hypothalamus deposit. In both author DESeq2 lists the female PND37 fits use PND32 or PND27 as baseline, and the female PND22-baseline fits end at PND27 or PND32. The archived cell-proportion tests include the requested ages but measure cell abundance. In the companion qPCR study, Figure S6B includes the female hypothalamus PND22/PND37 pair as an aggregate gene count. Table S4 names hypothalamic genes for PND12/PND22 only, and Table S7 gives sample measurements. The reviewed sources provide no gene-level author effect, raw P or adjusted P for the registered contrast. Its concordance remains unassessed.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen when an author-issued gene-level result explicitly identifies the female whole-hypothalamus PND37 versus PND22 libraries, orientation and effect definition. A labelled selected-gene result would reopen only those genes.
